YES.software_gpu_capable: The reviewer confirms a plausible AMD/ROCm execution path for the proposed software.
YES.code_previously_installed: The reviewer confirms previous installation/use or an available standard environment on LUMI.
YES.workplan_sufficient: The reviewer confirms sufficient technical workplan detail.
YES.scaling_strategy_adequate: The reviewer confirms that the execution strategy can use the requested concurrency.

NO.software_gpu_capable: The reviewer identifies an incompatibility with the target AMD GPU architecture.
NO.code_previously_installed: Prior LUMI installation is not established; installation work introduces startup risk.
NO.workplan_sufficient: The reviewer finds the technical workplan insufficient to assess feasibility.
NO.scaling_strategy_adequate: The reviewer finds the proposed execution strategy inadequate for the requested concurrency.
